summary: Habit re-entry: six short easy sessions, protect back, honour sleep deficit, build consistency over intensity

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin — Habit Reset
sessions.focus: Re-establish daily movement habit; pure aerobic base at Z1/Z2 boundary

steps.description: Easy spin, build cadence to 80-85 rpm, HR <145 bpm
Z2 steady, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR 146-158 bpm. Drop to 88-105W if HR climbs with sleep deficit.
Easy spin down, cadence drops naturally

sessions.name: Lower Body + Anti-Rotation Core
sessions.focus: Posterior chain, hip stability, spine-safe anti-rotation core — no spinal flexion under load
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 11kg, 8x TRX split squat per leg, 15x banded glute bridge (pause 1s at top), 2x20m farmer's carry 2x6kg, 10x Pallof press per side (light band, hold 2s). 60-90s rest between rounds. No spinal flexion under load. Posture over load throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and side, hip circles, 10x bodyweight squat, 10x bodyweight glute bridge
10x goblet squat 11kg → 8x TRX split squat per leg → 15x banded glute bridge → 2x20m farmer's carry 2x6kg → 10x Pallof press per side
Rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check posture for next round
Kneeling hip flexor stretch, figure-4 or pigeon pose, seated glute stretch — hold each 30-45s

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Weekly run stimulus; Z1 warm-up into Z2 aerobic, movement quality over pace

steps.description: Walk/jog Z1, >7:00/km, HR <145 bpm — let legs loosen
Z2 aerobic, 6:15-6:45/km, HR 146-162 bpm. If HR exceeds 162 bpm, slow to Z1 pace.
Walk or slow jog Z1, HR returning <145 bpm

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Flush legs post-run, parasympathetic recovery — deliberately easy

steps.description: Free spin, easy cadence, no pressure
Z1 upper / Z2 floor, cadence 88-95 rpm, HR <150 bpm. Drop to 70-88W if HR won't settle below 150.
Easy spin, cadence falls to ~70 rpm

sessions.name: Aerobic Cycling with Cadence Focus
sessions.focus: Aerobic efficiency and neuromuscular cadence economy at Z2

steps.description: Build cadence from 80 to 90 rpm, HR moving toward 146 bpm
Z2, cadence 90-95 rpm, HR 146-160 bpm. Smooth circles — prioritise cadence over power.
Easy spin recovery between efforts
Wind down, cadence 80 rpm, HR returning below 145 bpm

sessions.name: Longer Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Aerobic volume, fat oxidation, steady-state base — longest session of the week

steps.description: Build from 70W to 106W over 10 min, cadence 80-85 rpm
Z2 steady, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR 146-160 bpm. If HR drifts above 162 bpm in second half, reduce 10-15W — cardiac drift is expected.
15 min easy spin, HR returning below 145 bpm by end
